I fixed the per-rep purchase-order count so it no longer counts cancelled purchase orders. The `*SalesRep*` tests pass; I didn't run the rest of the suite or add a test for the cancelled case.

The change is one condition, `po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, added to the count subquery in `countPurchaseOrdersIntoSalesRepRegionsPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java` (around line 6517). The query still lists every rep, so reps with no purchase orders show 0. The ordering is unchanged, highest count first.

I haven't committed anything.
